experiment.hypothesis: Variant B asks for the loan amount immediately after the intro, before any qualifying question. We expect a low-effort, high-intent question to create commitment earlier and reduce drop-off on the income step, lifting end-to-end completion. Variant A keeps the conventional order: purpose first, amount later.
experiment.primaryMetric: cta_click_rate — unique sessions with cta_clicked divided by unique sessions with session_started
